mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit month-over-month growth, it signals synchronized supply-side expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with synchronized INDPRO and HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500B YoY indicates strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX returns falls below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market weakening, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with triggered UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a 5% MoM increase in HOUST signals rapid demand rebound, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism in post-shock regimes remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
